resources.string: Select your own decrypted Nintendo 3DS cartridge image (.3ds or .cci). Forge prepares the game on this device, without encryption keys or network access. The first installation takes several minutes. It continues in the background, also while the phone is locked, and shows its progress in a notification.
This build has no Forge package: it can only play a title prepared beforehand.
The selected file cannot be opened.
The application\'s Forge package cannot be prepared: %1$s
The game languages are read during the installation. %1$s
Install sets up the game in this language. You can change it later here or in game.
Choose the game language, then install.
The title is ready to play.
The previous installation stopped before it finished: the app was closed or stopped by the system. Select the ROM and install again; an installed title stays as it was.
Changes apply on the next full game start.
Game language saved. Applies on the next full game start.

Back up your saves, save states, settings and touch controls to one ZIP file in a place of your choice, and restore it here or on another device. Restore also imports a ZIP of saves exported by TriAevum or of the game\'s own save files (save00.bin and following, system.dat). Nothing is replaced before you confirm, and replaced files are kept. Mods, downloads and the game data made from your ROM are not in a backup.
On this device: %1$d save files, %2$d save states.
Restore a backup or import saves…
This backup was made on another platform. Saves, save states, the HUD layout, the game language and environments are restored; display, controls and window settings stay as they are here.
This backup was made with another revision of the game than the one installed here.
Before anything changes, every file the restore replaces or removes is copied into a restore folder (data/backups). If the restore is interrupted, the previous files are put back before you can play.
Restored. The replaced files are kept in %1$s.
An interrupted restore was undone; your previous files are back.
Exported %1$d files; %2$d files were left out (too large or not save files).
The archive holds %1$d save files and %2$d save states. %3$s Other saves stay as they are.
%1$d existing files with the same names will be replaced: %2$s. They are moved to a backup folder first (save-backups; the last %3$d imports are kept).
Imported %1$d files. The replaced files are kept in %2$s.
Close the game before importing saves.
This file is not a ZIP archive.
The archive contains an unsafe path: %1$s
The archive contains a file that is not a TriAevum save: %1$s
%1$s is larger than a save can be.
The archive contains too many files.
%1$s is not a TriAevum save state.
The archive is damaged or incomplete (%1$s).
There are no saves to export yet.
%1$s exists in the save folder but is not a file.

The report stays on this device unless you copy or share it. Review it first: it lists the device, Android\'s record of recent app exits, the game\'s startup stages, recent log lines of this app and Forge\'s report. Share diagnostics sends a zip of the files listed at the end (logs and settings, with folder and user names removed; never saves or game data).
The report could not be built (%1$s).
Diagnostics bundle (shared only with Share diagnostics):
The last session ended with: %1$s. A diagnostics report can help with an issue report; nothing is sent anywhere.
